architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared components in src/components/. Tailwind CSS for styling. React Router for navigation. No state management (local state sufficient).

tickets.title: Landing page (src/pages/Landing.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch screen `sentra_security_reinvented` to React component. Extract inline styles to Tailwind classes. Preserve exact layout, typography, spacing, colors. Mobile-responsive.
acceptance_criteria: All text, images, buttons render correctly

tickets.title: Style guide page (src/pages/StyleGuide.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch screen `obsidian_protocol_style_guide` to React component. Extract color palette, typography scale, spacing tokens to Tailwind config. Document tokens in src/styles/README.md.
acceptance_criteria: All design tokens match Stitch screen

tickets.title: Shared components (src/components/) - Buttons & Cards
tickets.description: Extract reusable buttons and cards from Stitch screen `component_showcase_buttons_cards`. Create src/components/Button.jsx and src/components/Card.jsx. Support all variants shown in design. Prop API: { variant, size, children, onClick }.
acceptance_criteria: Components used in StyleGuide page for showcase

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create app shell. Add navigation bar with links to Landing and StyleGuide pages. Set up React Router with routes: `/` (Landing), `/style-guide` (StyleGuide). Dark/light mode toggle (default dark).
